items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: Ralph Collins is here to say something... I wondered if you can remember anything that he said about Jimmy Noon.

ctx.x: Yeah, go ahead, Ralph Collins is here to say something, go ahead.
